nativeStartupBackground.webView: MainActivity.load() resolves R.color.lifelog_background and applies it to the window/WebView before super.load() creates Bridge and loads the URL; onConfigurationChanged reapplies after system resources update.
nativeStartupBackground.config: No fixed backgroundColor; installed Capacitor only sets the WebView background when its config value is non-null. No unsupported SystemBars background API.
